title: Supervisor Institutional Affairs (Regulatory Area)
description:
**Supervisor Institutional Affairs (Regulatory Area)**

**Location:** Rome**.**

  

At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a future without cigarettes. With huge change comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions. You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact. PMI’s shift from selling cigarettes to our new combustion\-free products has changed the way we work, our stakeholder engagement and how we communicate. Bring us your curiosity and a desire to challenge the everyday and we’ll give you lots of responsibility. You’ll help us improve, inject innovation and create new ways of working.

 **Your Role**


The **Supervisor Institutional Affairs (Regulatory Area)** plays a key role in supporting the development and implementation of the company’s external engagement strategy. The position contributes to building sustainable and predictable policy frameworks by engaging with policymakers, Italian and European institutions, and regulatory authorities. It includes monitoring political and policy trends affecting both conventional products and non\-combustible alternatives, ensuring alignment with the company’s global transformation toward innovation. The role supports the Senior Manager and cross‑functional EU and global teams on projects involving Italy, strengthens relationships with national and international stakeholders, and ensures timely information flow to guide strategic planning and execution. In particular, the Supervisor will oversee institutional engagement and projects at Italian levels, as well as studies and multistakeholder platforms that are part of the Corporate affairs strategy.

 **What You’ll Do**

* Support public affairs initiatives by maintaining and strengthening relationships with key institutional and political stakeholders, ensuring effective implementation of the global/EU strategy at national and local level.
* Assist the Senior Manager and External Affairs Director in stakeholder engagement activities, particularly on regulatory matters, contributing to the definition and execution of the regulatory affairs strategy.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of Italy’s public affairs strategy and action plan, supporting the evolution of the regulatory framework, particularly at national level.
* Oversee the relationship with external partners, supporting the design and review of studies, analyses, and projects focused on regulatory policy.
* Monitor and analyse political and regulatory trends, identifying relevant and emerging topics within the regulatory landscape.
* Prepare high‑quality notes, briefings, and analytical documents on regulatory developments and the broader national industry context.
* Coordinate the preparation of engagement materials (notes, speeches, presentations) for external events and support the company's participation, including that of senior leadership.
* Collaborate with internal functions to ensure cross‑functional alignment with external affairs priorities and overall company strategy.

 **Skills \& Capabilities**

* Degree in Economics, Law, Political Science or related fields.
* Proven experience of at least 5\-6 years in External Affairs, Advocacy or Government/Regulatory Affairs roles.
* Solid understanding of national and EU political and regulatory processes.
* Proven experience in developing and implementing multistakeholder projects with policy relevance and law/economic studies and reports.
* Ability to analyze legislation, regulatory frameworks and policy trends.
* Experience in stakeholder engagement with institutions, industry bodies and external partners.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking.
* High autonomy, reliability, discretion and strong organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Italian and English (mandatory).

 **Rewards \& Benefits**

* We offer a Permanent Contract.
* In this position you will earn no less than 64,540 € gross yearly.
* Where the role allows it, you can benefit from flexible ways of working, combining time in the workplace with remote working.
* You will have access to a welfare ecosystem that supports different needs, including health, education, family care, free time, mobility, reimbursements and other services.
* We offer initiatives designed to support our people in important life moments, including parental leave, parenting and caregiving resources, and services that can help with family\-related needs.

 **Application Process**


Our recruitment process will be handled carefully by our Talent Acquisition team.
  

We follow three key steps:

* **Step 1: Application submission \& CV screening.**
* **Step 2: Interviews and an assessment** (assessment depends on the position you apply for. You might go through various steps, such as resume screening, written tests, interviews, focus group discussions, and business case presentations).
* **Step 3: Offer and onboarding.**


Once the interviews and assessments are complete, our team will take the time to review all candidates before the final decision is made and will provide feedback accordingly.

 **Equal Opportunities Statement**


We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and identities and provide reasonable accommodation to ensure an accessible recruitment process. If you need support or adjustments during your application, let us know—we’re here to help you succeed.

title: Specialist/Snr Specialist Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs
description:
**Company Description**  

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.


Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.


We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.


That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work\-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.


If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

 **Job Description**  

The Senior Specialist, Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs leads and coordinates all activities related  

to achieving site initiation readiness. The role provides subject matter expertise, ensures regulatory  

compliance, and serves as a key liaison between internal teams, clients, and external stakeholders

* Accountable for delivery of assigned study start\-up and regulatory milestones within defined scope.
* Make independent decisions within assigned scope regarding regulatory processes and documentation approaches.
* Handles medium\-complexity regulatory environments, including multi\-country requirements where applicable.
* Leads study start\-up and regulatory activities for assigned countries or projects of medium complexity, ensuring delivery in line with timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Leads preparation, review, and quality control of regulatory and study start\-up documentation (including submissions, essential documents, and translations) to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with ICH\-GCP and country\-specific requirements.
* Responsible for drafting, negotiating, finalizing, and executing clinical site agreements, ancillary agreements as well as amendments at country or regional level, in accordance with project requirements and country regulations and within the projected delivery timelines
* Review all relevant documentation e.g. labels, patient information sheets, diary cards, insurance etc, to ensure compliance with ICH GCP \& country specific requirements.
* Contribute towards the preparation and/or review of complex technical/scientific/legal documentation.
* Arrange for and/or review translation of essential documents as required
* Provide regulatory/SSU strategic input to internal and external customers. Develop the regulatory strategy and the SSU Plan, joint operating procedures and core documents
* Promptly identify and escalate risk/potential risk to the project team which may jeopardise deliverables; support corrective/preventive actions
* Performs other work\-related duties as assigned.

 **Qualifications**  

* Graduate degree in Chemistry or Life Sciences, Nursing or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Minimum 4 years within pharmaceutical or CRO industry or Regulatory body
* Good knowledge of ICH GCP and national regulations for territories of competency
* Good understanding of specific country requirements pertaining to SSU/Regulatory delivery in multiple countries within Europe and/or the Americas

  

**Additional Information**  

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.


We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
* Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
* Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
* Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
* Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
* Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.


We look forward to welcoming your application.

title: Enterprise Systems Specialist
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard Office Hours (40/wk)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**DESCRIPTION**
===============

**Position Overview**
---------------------


As *Enterprise Systems Specialist* at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a crucial role in supporting the implementation, lifecycle management, and ongoing operation of business\-critical enterprise applications at the manufacturing site level.


You will act as a key coordination point between site business users, Global IT and Application teams, ERP teams, Infrastructure, vendors, implementation partners, and support teams. You will use your functional and technical knowledge of enterprise applications and business processes to clarify requirements, support process reengineering, manage site\-level application governance, and coordinate activities across the full application lifecycle.


You will also play a key role in the site's multi\-year PMX decommissioning program, supporting the transition of material handling, warehouse, and quality\-related processes to SAP while ensuring reliable operation and continuity of existing enterprise applications.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as the main site\-level IT coordination, support, and governance contact for assigned applications and related projects.
* Build strong working relationships with Supply Chain, Quality, Warehouse, Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, Site IT, Global Application teams, ERP teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
* Coordinate application lifecycle activities including requirements, design, configuration, testing, training, go\-live, hypercare, support handover, upgrades, and steady\-state operations.
* Play a key role in the PMX decommissioning program, coordinating site activities related to the transition of material handling, warehouse, and quality processes to SAP.
* Track, prioritize, and escalate application issues, risks, dependencies, decisions, and readiness actions, ensuring clear business impact, ownership, and timely follow\-up.
* Coordinate functional and technical discussions between site users, Global IT teams, ERP teams, Application teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
* Capture business feedback, process gaps, user needs, integration requirements, and local constraints in a structured way.
* Coordinate site readiness for user access, roles, master data dependencies, interfaces, infrastructure requirements, and connectivity.
* Support testing, validation, and compliance activities by coordinating business inputs and action closure with Quality and Validation teams.
* Support and maintain assigned enterprise applications such as SAP\-related solutions, Maximo, Kinaxis, PlanetTogether, and other business\-critical platforms.
* Coordinate vendors and support providers for incidents, changes, upgrades, and application lifecycle activities.

**Compliance \& Documentation**
-------------------------------

* Ensure documentation readiness for enterprise applications, user roles, business processes, support models, SOPs, work instructions, and training materials.
* Coordinate CSV and compliance inputs with Quality and Validation teams for GxP\-relevant applications.
* Ensure documentation is updated when applications, interfaces, access models, business processes, or support models change.
* Support periodic user access reviews, application lifecycle reviews, and other required compliance activities.
* Maintain clear records of key decisions, open actions, issue follow\-up, knowledge transfer, and support handover.
* Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits by providing required application documentation and follow\-up.

**Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------

* Coordinate site support for assigned applications and ensure effective user support and issue follow\-up.
* Identify recurring issues, support gaps, training needs, technical debt, and improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate application changes, impact assessments, testing, documentation updates, training, and user adoption.
* Support process simplification and standardization through global enterprise platforms and reduced reliance on legacy or locally customized solutions.
* Contribute to application lifecycle planning, upgrade roadmaps, and replacement strategies.

**REQUIREMENTS**
================

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience supporting enterprise application implementations, lifecycle management, or Site IT projects in manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of business processes supported by enterprise applications, including warehouse, material management, supply chain, quality, maintenance, or related functions.
* Strong functional and technical understanding of enterprise applications and their integration within manufacturing environments.
* Experience in business process reengineering, requirements clarification, and translating business needs into system requirements.
* Understanding of regulated manufacturing environments and CSV expectations is preferred.

**Key Proficiencies**
---------------------

* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, follow\-up, and issue\-tracking skills.
* Good ability to build effective relationships across business, Site IT, global application teams, and external partners.
* Knowledge of enterprise application lifecycle management, including requirements, configuration, testing, deployment, support, change management, and upgrades.
* Good understanding of SAP and its integration with manufacturing, warehouse, quality, maintenance, MES, and other enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of Maximo, Kinaxis, PlanetTogether, PMX, PharmaSuite, or comparable enterprise platforms is an advantage.
* Understanding of application interfaces, master data, user roles and access, integrations, and support models.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear functional and technical inputs for global or external delivery teams.
* Practical problem\-solving approach focused on execution, user support, application reliability, and business continuity.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are beneficial.

title: Villa Residence Rector (Rome, Italy)
description:
**Company Description**  

The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace; it is a vibrant, mission\-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit. Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well\-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world. Whether contributing to world\-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you!

 **Job Description** **Work Authorization Note for the Villa Residence Rector Role:**

***Our standard application system automatically includes a question regarding U.S. work authorization. Please disregard this field (or answer accordingly) \- the actual requirement for this role is eligibility to work in Italy. The University does not sponsor work visas for this position.***

  

The Rector oversees the Villa student residence, the Living Learning Community of the University of Notre Dame in Rome. The Rector lives in residence with the students and reports directly to the Director for Student Programs (or their designee).


While specific duties may vary, the Rector is called to serve as Chief Administrator, Community Leader, Pastoral Leader, and University Resource. The role includes, but is not limited to, the following:

**Chief Administrator**

* Participate in regular meetings for ongoing supervision and professional development, including annual NDG Staff Training for residence hall personnel.
* Supervise, train, and direct the professional development of the Villa staff.
* Ensure University policies regarding student conduct (including *du Lac* and Villa\-specific guidelines) are consistently implemented and documented via the Villa Log, Maxient, and/or NDG Incident Reports.
* Coordinate and participate in on\-duty, in\-office, and emergency response rotations (day/night/weekends/holidays) while programs are in session.
* Facilitate and document repairs, maintenance, and cleaning operations under the guidance of the Director of International Facilities.
* Liaise with Villa security personnel in collaboration with the Director for Student Programs.
* Develop and implement pre\-departure preparations and on\-site orientations for new student cohorts.
* Coordinate semester turnover operations, including kitchen inventory and linen services.
* Supervise the implementation of the Villa meal plan.
* Write letters of recommendation for students.

**Community Leader**

* Build personal relationships with all residents to understand and address their individual needs.
* Proactively build a safe, welcoming, and vibrant community for both Villa and non\-Villa residents.
* Establish dialogue with students who are less involved in the residential community.
* Create opportunities to celebrate the diversity of the resident body and the broader ND community.
* Support the academic mission of Notre Dame Rome and undergraduate learning outcomes.
* Foster the integration of students within the local Roman community and encourage the study of the Italian language.
* Organize and attend community programs and events, managing the monthly Villa event budget.
* Collaborate with colleagues to integrate faith and learning within the context of the city of Rome.

**Pastoral Leader**

* Serve as an active and visible witness of a committed Christian life.
* Promote opportunities for Catholic worship and plan events according to the liturgical calendar.
* Exercise a “ministry of presence” and reach out to marginalized or vulnerable students.
* Address disciplinary issues in collaboration with the Office of Community Standards.
* Act as a mediator to resolve conflicts between residents.
* Provide pastoral care, support, and crisis management for students of concern.
* Collaborate with Student Affairs professionals, faculty, and families when supporting students in difficulty.

**University Resource**

* Execute integrated procedures for monitoring and supporting student wellbeing.
* Liaise with local providers and University officials to ensure timely and documented responses to physical or mental health concerns.
* Serve as a primary liaison for faculty, staff, and parents.
* Maintain deep knowledge of University structures and direct students toward appropriate resources.
* Share critical information with the Rome Incident Response Team, Deputy Title IX Coordinator, and the CARE Team as appropriate.
* Develop and implement periodic surveys for data collection and prepare reports.
* Serve on annual task groups or University committees as required.

 ***This is a full\-time (38 hours per week), 6\-month position with the possibility of extension.***

 **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree
* At least 2 years of experience in a related field such as pastoral ministry, education, student personnel or counseling
* Advanced proficiency in English and Italian
* Experience living in Rome
* Ability to legally work and live in Italy at the time of application

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of the structure, mission, and values of institutions of Catholic higher education
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in higher education with faculty, staff and students
* Knowledge of student life issues
* Effective interpersonal skills, including a willingness to create a welcoming environment for all people
* Ability to design and implement educational programming with and for students
* Capacity to manage stress and maintain personal and emotional stability in a demanding work environment
* Strong communication skills, both written and oral, with a facility for public speaking
* Strong organizational skills, with a demonstrated attention to detail
* Competent with technology (MS Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Gmail Suite) and ability to learn new systems

  

**Additional Information** **Compensation:** €30,000\-32,000

***This is a full\-time (38 hours per week), 6\-month position with the possibility of extension.***

**Application Requirements:** Resume/CV, Cover Letter, and 3 Professional References

* ***This position will be accepting applications until September 20, 2026***
* ***The preferred start date for this position is October 2026***

**Benefits:**

* Private, single\-use residence on the property in a studio apartment. Utilities are included.
* Three dinners/week while classes are in session (if applicable)
* University provided cell\-phone and plan
* Free access and use of laundry facilities
* Wi\-Fi connection

*The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment. Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60\-741\.5(a) and 41 CFR 60\-300\.5(a). We strongly encourage applications from candidates attracted to a university with a Catholic identity.*

**Job Description:**  

At Angelini Pharma, we are committed to improving people's lives through innovation, science, and strategic growth. To support our ambitious development agenda, we are looking for an experienced Director, Legal M\&A to join our Legal \& Compliance team.
  
  

In this pivotal role, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, leading the legal strategy and execution of high\-impact mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, licensing agreements, and strategic partnerships across international markets. You will work at the intersection of law, business, and innovation, contributing directly to the company's growth and transformation journey.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

M\&A Transaction Management
  
  

Lead end\-to\-end legal management of M\&A transactions, including acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic alliances across all relevant jurisdictions.
  
Draft, review, and negotiate transaction documents including Letters of Intent (LOI), Term Sheets, Share Purchase Agreements (SPA), Asset Purchase Agreements, Merger Agreements, Shareholders' Agreements, and ancillary documents.
  
Manage and coordinate legal due diligence processes, identifying key legal risks and proposing appropriate mitigation strategies or contractual protections.
  
Coordinate with external law firms and advisors, ensuring quality, cost\-effectiveness, and consistency of legal advice.
  
  

Corporate \& Regulatory Compliance
  
  

Ensure all transactions comply with applicable corporate laws, antitrust/competition regulations, foreign investment rules, and sector\-specific pharmaceutical regulations (EMA, national authorities, etc.).
  
Manage regulatory filings and notifications required in connection with M\&A transactions (e.g., merger control filings, FDI reviews).
  
Monitor legislative and regulatory developments affecting M\&A activity in the pharmaceutical and life sciences sector.
  
  

Business Partnering \& Strategic Advisory
  
  

Act as a strategic legal advisor to senior management and the Business Development team, providing clear and pragmatic legal guidance on deal strategy and risk appetite.
  
Participate in deal screening and target evaluation from a legal risk perspective.
  
Support the CLCO in reporting to the Board and relevant committees on M\&A\-related legal matters.
  
  

Contracts \& Intellectual Property
  
  

Oversee legal aspects related to IP rights (patents, trademarks, licences) in the context of M\&A and licensing transactions.
  
Review and negotiate licensing and collaboration agreements with pharmaceutical partners, biotech companies, and research institutions.
  
  

Team \& Vendor Management
  
  

Lead and mentor junior legal team members supporting M\&A activities.
  
Manage relationships with external law firms, ensuring appropriate panel management and fee controls.
  
Contribute to the continuous improvement of legal processes, templates, and playbooks for M\&A transactions.

Education
  
  

Qualified lawyer with a Master's Degree in Law and admission to practice (Italian Bar or equivalent EU qualification preferred).
  
10\+ years of experience in M\&A, corporate law, and strategic transactions, gained within leading international law firms and/or multinational companies.
  
Proven track record of successfully leading complex cross\-border transactions from deal inception through closing and integration.
  
Experience within the pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or highly regulated industries is a strong advantage.
  
  

Expertise
  
  

Deep knowledge of corporate law, M\&A, contract law, competition/antitrust regulations, and corporate governance.
  
Strong understanding of legal due diligence processes and transaction documentation.
  
Familiarity with intellectual property and licensing matters within innovation\-driven sectors.
  
  

Soft Skills \& Leadership Competencies
  
  

Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and commercial awareness.
  
Exceptional negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
  
Able to navigate complexity, manage multiple priorities, and make sound decisions under pressure.
  
Collaborative, proactive, and solution\-oriented approach.
  
Highest standards of integrity, judgment, and professional ethics.

title: Nature Principal Consultant
description:
### **Description**

  

We are seeking a highly motivated **Principal Consultant** with deep subject matter expertise in nature\-related dependencies, impacts, risks, and opportunities (**DIROs**). In this role, you will provide technical leadership and strategic insight to Anthesis clients across a wide array of sectors.  

Your core mission will be to lead and deliver strategic client engagements while driving business development efforts, helping organizations assess and effectively respond to nature\-related risks and opportunities.### **Key Responsibilities**

 **Technical Leadership – Nature Frameworks \& DIROs*** **Act as a subject matter expert** in nature\-related DIRO assessments, applying TNFD\-aligned methodologies to identify, assess, and prioritize nature\-related risks and opportunities.
* **Provide technical leadership** on **ESRS E4** (Biodiversity \& Ecosystems), supporting clients in meeting **CSRD** disclosure requirements, including double materiality, metrics, and transition plans.
* **Guide clients** in **SBTN** target setting, including scoping, baseline development, and alignment with *no conversion of natural ecosystems* and *freshwater targets*.
* **Lead the implementation of EUDR regulations**, assisting clients in interpreting and operationalizing requirements such as due diligence systems, traceability, geolocation, and risk assessments.
* **Ensure consistency** with leading guidance, including **AFi**, the **TNFD LEAP** approach, and emerging best practices in nature\-related financial risk management.

**Project Management \& Delivery of Client Projects*** **Lead and deliver** nature\-related assessments (DIRO, footprinting, baselining) and translate outputs into clear priorities, action plans, and transition strategies.
* **Support clients** in embedding nature into enterprise risk management, strategy, and disclosures, including integration with climate, supply chain, and financial decision\-making.
* **Provide technical oversight** and quality assurance across complex, multi\-workstream engagements.
* **Develop high\-quality deliverables**, including TNFD\-aligned reports, ESRS disclosures, and executive\-ready insights.

**Strategic Advisory \& Implementation*** **Advise clients** on operationalizing nature strategies, moving seamlessly from commitments and disclosure to implementation across value chains.
* **Support the development** of nature transition plans, including governance, KPIs, and monitoring frameworks.
* **Translate technical findings** into commercially relevant insights, articulating the business case for action on nature (risk mitigation, resilience, and growth opportunities).

**Methodology \& Offering Development*** **Lead the development and refinement** of Anthesis’ methodologies and tools for DIRO assessments, TNFD alignment, and EUDR/ESRS compliance.
* **Contribute to internal knowledge development**, ensuring Anthesis remains at the forefront of evolving nature frameworks and regulations.
* **Develop reusable assets**, templates, and training materials to scale delivery quality globally.
* **Partner with digital teams** to advance and scale our digital\-based offerings.

**Client \& Business Development*** **Build trusted relationships** with senior client stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor on nature\-related topics.
* **Lead or support proposal development** for opportunities related to EUDR, TNFD, SBTN, ESRS/CSRD, and nature strategy.
* **Identify opportunities** to expand client engagements from diagnostics (DIRO) to full implementation (targets, transition plans, and transformation).

**Developing \& Strengthening Team Expertise*** **Mentor and coach** consultants, building internal capability on TNFD, SBTN, ESRS, EUDR, and DIRO methodologies.
* **Deliver internal and external training** on nature\-related frameworks and best practices.
* **Contribute thought leadership** to strengthen Anthesis’ market positioning in nature advisory.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

 **Technical Expertise \& Frameworks*** **8\+ years of experience** in nature, biodiversity, natural capital, or ecosystem services.
* **Demonstrated expertise** in nature\-related **DIRO** assessments, including the practical application of **TNFD** (specifically the **LEAP** approach).
* **Strong working knowledge** of **ESRS E4** (Biodiversity \& Ecosystems) and broader **CSRD** requirements, including an understanding of **double materiality** and nature\-related financial risk.
* **Experience supporting or advising** on **SBTN** target\-setting or equivalent science\-based approaches.
* **Deep familiarity** with leading frameworks, guidance, and disclosure standards, including **TNFD**, **EUDR**, **SBTN**, **ESRS/CSRD**, **AFi**, **GRI**, **ISSB**, and **CDP** (Forests/nature modules).
* **Proven ability** to assess value chain risks, land\-use change, and ecosystem impacts.

**Data, Analytics \& Modeling*** **Experience working with complex datasets** and successfully translating technical outputs into strategic, business\-relevant insights.
* **Familiarity with technical tools** such as **GIS** (ArcGIS, QGIS), geospatial data, natural capital assessment tools, and advanced **Excel\-based modeling**.

**Project Leadership \& Client Delivery*** **Proven ability to lead complex, multi\-stakeholder projects** and consistently deliver high\-quality outputs.
* **Strong capability to translate intricate technical frameworks** into actionable business strategies.
* **Experience working with multinational clients** across diverse sectors (e.g., FMCG, retail, agriculture, and finance).
* **Strong technical credibility** seamlessly combined with strategic and commercial acumen.

**Language Capabilities*** **Fluency in English** (both written and verbal) is strictly required for client delivery.
* **Fluency in Spanish** is a highly distinct advantage.
* **Additional language capabilities** are preferred to support global and regional engagements.

**Mindset \& Core Attributes*** **Collaborative and globally minded**, with the proven ability to work effectively across diverse cultures and time zones.
* **Passionate** about advancing **nature\-positive** outcomes and driving systemic change.
* **Detail\-oriented**, with a deep commitment to excellence and rigorous quality assurance.
* **Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable** operating in a fast\-evolving regulatory and market landscape.

**Eligibility to work*** Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the country of employment.
* **Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.**

  

### **Job Benefits**

  

* Work within a highly motivated team in an innovative and rapidly growing global company.
* Opportunity to have a direct impact and be a key part of the growth and development of the business and the team.
* Work solely on projects that have an impact on the sustainability and climate change goals/challenges for clients.
* Opportunity to work with, collaborate with and learn from sustainability SME’s who are passionate about the work they do and the impact Anthesis can have.
* Exposure to a wide range of clients and projects on a global basis.
* Competitive salary in line with, experience and skills.
* Cooperative, supportive and open working atmosphere.

  

### **About Anthesis Group**


**Our commitment to building and maintaining a diverse workforce**  

  

Anthesis has clients across all industry sectors and supports some of the world’s largest multinationals such as Reckitt, Cisco, Tesco, The North Face, and Target. The company brings together 1,300\+ experts operating across 22 countries and 44 office locations with offices in Australia, Belgium, Brazil, Canada, China, Colombia, Finland, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Ireland, Italy, the Middle East, Netherlands, the Philippines, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the UK, and the US.  

  

We encourage all employees to contribute their ideas, perspectives, and experiences to help us create an inclusive and equitable workplace. By embracing diversity and providing equal opportunities, we believe we can drive innovation, foster creativity, and achieve our shared goals. So, if you’re ready to be a part of something truly extraordinary, then we want you! Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.  

  

Together, we can continue to build a diverse and inclusive workforce where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and thrive.  

  

If you require any reasonable adjustments to be made to your application process, or need this job advert in a different format, just let us know and we’ll be happy to help.
